card.name: Just before "imaged" in scanning text
card.fires_on: The start of "imaged" or "imaging" ("im" before "aged"/"aging"), and short words like "be" or "are" where "imaged" or "scanned" is expected next. Seen in MRI, scanning and nuclear imaging passages.
